content_blocks.title: Reference example: Pub/Sub Delivery Characteristics
content_blocks.code:
SUBSCRIBE demo:notifications
# In a second terminal:
PUBLISH demo:notifications "refresh"
content_blocks.expected_output: First terminal receives the published message while subscribed.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Pub/Sub is best-effort broadcast to online subscribers, not a durable queue. Run the commands in two local terminals.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Unsubscribe in the first terminal; no durable record is stored.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
